title: Human commercial persuasion runtime
problem: Commercial knowledge existed across persuasion, sales and copy layers, but was not consistently runtime-decisive before outbound execution.
decision: Reuse the existing persuasion optimizer as the canonical psychology authority, combine it with channel-specific sales plays, evidence-bound human copy generation, deterministic quality gates, executor fail-closed behavior and outcome performance learning.
invariant: No outbound message may rely on fabricated evidence, fake urgency, hidden commitment, sensitive-trait profiling or generic bot copy. Persuasion changes framing, never truth.
evidence: 17/17 pending commercial actions persuasion-labeled after backfill
